note:
PEOPLE THIS ARCHIVE ESTABLISHED FROM A DOCUMENT, NOT FROM THE SOURCE TREE.
The register is built from the MyHeritage harvest, which is somebody else's research. These seven are not in it and never were: they come out of Berlin civil registers and the 1939 census, read here. Adding them to the harvest file would have corrupted its provenance, so they are a THIRD CLASS with their own file, their own id block (9600000+) and their own label on the page.
EVERY ENTRY CARRIES ITS OWN BASIS. Some are a register entry read at the image; two are a text layer not yet confirmed at the image, and say so. NONE IS PROVED KIN TO DERRICK'S LINE, which is the same standing of the hundred people in the surname index.

people.name: Heinrich Leibholz
people.basis: DOCUMENTED. Death in the register, read at the image: Standesamt Kreuzberg, Sterberegister 1948 Nr. 2493, under the August heading of P Rep. 510 Nr. 667 p.180, the day column running in step with the register numbers either side. Birth date and birthplace from the 1939 census card.

facts.c: Sterberegister Kreuzberg 1948 Nr. 2493. He lived in Neukölln and died in Kreuzberg; Neukölln's own 1948 index is read and empty.

people.name: Agnes Leibholz (Kerger)
people.basis: DOCUMENTED ALIVE, DEATH NOT FOUND. Born at MALLMITZ, KREIS SPROTTAU, SILESIA — today Małomice in Poland, so she had no home region left to return to after 1945. 1939 census supplementary card VZ153403, Bundesarchiv R 1509; "race" NNNN, four non-Jewish grandparents, so she is in a database of the persecuted only by marriage. Berlin directories and telephone books at Mehringdamm 109 from 1957 to 1979-80. NOT IN ANY WEST BERLIN DEATH REGISTER 1967-1994: all twelve boroughs read, year coverage verified, only Neukölln 1993-94 missing.

facts.place: Mallmitz, Kreis Sprottau, Silesia — today Małomice, Poland

facts.c: Berlin directories and telephone books; absent from 1980-81
NOT ESTABLISHED. She died after 1994, or outside Berlin. The Berlin indexes stop at 1994 and she would have been 105.

people.name: Ella Josephine Martha Leibholz (Baesler)
people.basis: DOCUMENTED. Standesamt Tiergarten, Sterberegister 1974 Nr. 1160, read at the image. CANDIDATE, NOT PROVED, for the Ella Leibholz who is a Krankenschwester in the Berlin directories 1938-1970 at Dominicusstraße 43 and Willmanndamm 3: surname, forename and a four-year gap, with Schöneberg's own registers read out for 1970-1994 and empty. No birth date on the index entry.

facts.c: Sterberegister Tiergarten 1974 Nr. 1160, "Leibholz geb. Baesler", ev.

people.name: Charlotte Herta Marie Leibholz (Schötzow)
people.basis: DOCUMENTED. Standesamt Tempelhof, Sterberegister 1982 Nr. 161, read at the image. CANDIDATE, NOT PROVED, for the Charlotte Leibholz of Hasenheide 61-62, Neukölln, in the directories 1957-1967: surname, forename and the adjacent borough, with Neukölln's own registers read out for 1967-1992 and empty. The gap is fifteen years, the weakest of the three.

facts.c: Sterberegister Tempelhof 1982 Nr. 161, "Leibholz geb. Schötzow", ev. The OCR mangled her surname to "LEibhOo1z" and swept it onto the row above; she was found by eye.

people.name: Hilde Henriette Leibholz
people.basis: DOCUMENTED. Standesamt Wilmersdorf, Sterberegister 1983 Nr. 304, read at the image. THE STRONGEST OF THE THREE CANDIDATES and the only one who died in her own borough: Hilde Leibholz is in nine consecutive telephone books at Wiesbadener Straße 57, Wilmersdorf, to 1980-81, and the gap is about two years. No "geb." on the entry, so Leibholz was her own name.

people.name: Hertha Leibholz
people.basis: *** NOT YET CONFIRMED AT THE IMAGE. *** Found in the TEXT LAYER of Standesamt Zehlendorf, Namensverzeichnis zum Sterberegister 1983, P Rep. 721 Nr. 2767 p.80: "Leibholz gesch. Katznol Hertha … 2733". "Gesch." is geschieden, so Leibholz is most likely her own name and Katznol the marriage she left. The exact death date is not read.

facts.c: Sterberegister Zehlendorf 1983 Nr. 2733 — text layer only, not confirmed at the image

people.name: Gerda Felicitas Bade (Leibholz)
people.basis: DOCUMENTED, AND THE IMAGE CANNOT CONFIRM IT — WHICH REVERSES THIS ARCHIVE'S USUAL RULE. Standesamt Wilmersdorf, Sterberegister 1993 Nr. 312, P Rep. 570 Nr. 3306. Both her entries were opened on 9 October: “Bade geb. Leibholz, Gerda Felicitas, 15.02.1993” on page 7 under B and “Leibholz, Gerda Felicitas, 15.02.1993” on page 74 under L, THE SAME NUMBER 312 FROM TWO UNRELATED POSITIONS SIXTY-SEVEN PAGES APART — the series checking itself. The page SCAN is a faint degraded photocopy and her line is barely resolvable, so there is no image confirmation; for these 1993 volumes the text layer is NOT OCR of that scan but a clean born-digital transcription, and it is the better witness. SHE WAS BORN A LEIBHOLZ AND MARRIED OUT, so she had Leibholz parents in Berlin within living memory and is the only one of the seven pointing upward. HER FATHER IS NOT REACHABLE FREE: the marriage indexes stop at 1944 and every volume tested is completely blind, and her index entry carries no birth date to narrow by. Sterberegister Wilmersdorf 1993 Nr. 312 would name her parents outright.

facts.c: Sterberegister Wilmersdorf 1993 Nr. 312 — text layer only, not confirmed at the image

people.name: Johanne Klara Leipsholz (Diedring)
people.basis: DOCUMENTED, READ AT THE IMAGE. Standesamt Kreuzberg, Sterberegister 1960 Nr. 316, P Rep. 510 Nr. 679 p.123 under the Februar heading; religion column a dash. THE SURNAME IS SPELT LEIPSHOLZ, WITH AN S — a ninth spelling of this name and a registrar's own, not a machine's, read at five times magnification. STRONG CANDIDATE, NOT PROVED, for the KLARA LEIPHOLZ, Putzmacherin, of SW 29 Dieffenbachstraße 58 who is in the Berlin directories of 1957 and 1959 and gone after: the forename is Klara, the borough is Kreuzberg, and she died in the FIRST BLIND YEAR after her last directory entry, with 1959 read at the image and empty and 1963-1994 swept and empty. Against it: the spelling differs by a letter and “geb. Diedring” is a maiden name this archive has never held. Kreuzberg 1960 Nr. 316 gives the last address and settles it. NOT KIN TO ANYONE HERE ON ANY EVIDENCE.

facts.c: Sterberegister Kreuzberg 1960 Nr. 316, "Leipsholz geb. Diedring", no confession stated
